## Code Comments Language

All code comments, documentation (JSDoc/dartdoc), TODO annotations, and inline explanations MUST be written in **English**, regardless of the language used in conversation with the user.

This includes:
- Single-line comments (`//`)
- Multi-line comments (`/* */`)
- Documentation comments (`///`)
- TODO/FIXME annotations
- Commit message suggestions

Variable names, function names, and class names must also remain in English.
